exits.label: Storage Door
exits.text: The side door leads back to the basement storage room.

verbs.look: A side door back to storage. It looks thin enough to lose an argument with a shoulder.
verbs.pickup: I am not picking up a door. Even I have limits.

use.text: I step back into basement storage.

exits.label: Garage Door
exits.lockedText: The street is beyond the garage door. Leaving on foot is not the plan.
exits.text: The garage door faces the street. The car is alive enough to try.

verbs.look: The garage door faces the street. Without the car running, it is just a bigger way to die outside.
verbs.pickup: The whole garage door? Cute thought. Bad physics.

use.lockedText: The street is beyond the garage door. Leaving on foot is not the plan.
use.text: The garage door faces the street. The car is alive enough to try.

action.text: I get the car through the garage door. The street receives me without mercy.

driveSequence.afterText: The next block slides beside the windows. I keep both hands on the wheel.

action.text: I stay in the garage a moment longer.

verbs.look: The hood is bent shut. The latch is buried in warped metal. Fingers will not win this debate.
verbs.pickup: I am not carrying the hood around like a shield. Wrong genre.

use.text: Use what on the hood? Something with leverage, not optimism.

verbs.look: A small panel under the hood. Screws first. Then the empty slot. Capitalism even privatized electricity from the dead.
verbs.pickup: I need what goes inside the panel, not the panel itself.

use.text: Use what on the fuse panel? Tool first, part second.

verbs.look: The fuel cap is cold and mean. The tank is dry enough to feel personal.
verbs.pickup: The fuel cap stays with the car. I need fuel, not souvenirs.

use.text: Use what on the fuel cap? The tank is not accepting poetry.

verbs.pickup: I am not picking up the car. Not today, not with these shoulders.

onEnter.text: The garage is quiet enough to hear the car cooling in its own dust. Useful tools should be here. Of course they are not.

#0000ff.label: Car
#0000ff.text: The car sits under dust like a promise nobody can afford yet.

verbs.pickup: I am not picking up the car. Not today, not with these shoulders.

#00ffff.label: Window
#00ffff.text: A barred window shows a slice of cold blue outside. Nothing moves there right now.

#ffff00.label: Tool Board
#ffff00.text: The hooks are empty. Little clean shapes in the dust show where useful things used to hang.

#00ff00.label: Workbench
#00ff00.text: The workbench has scratches, oil rings, and no mercy. Somebody stripped it before I got here.

#ff8800.label: Supply Shelf
#ff8800.text: Old packaging, dead screws, and a fuse box label. The part itself is gone.

#ff00ff.label: Fuel Stain
#ff00ff.text: A dark gasoline ring stains the floor. The can was moved, probably downstairs.

#808080.label: Tire
#808080.text: A loose tire leans against warped boards. Nothing here is ready to move fast.
